conviction_note: No profit warning, no pre-release and no guidance to change (the company gives no outlook, and its 2025-2027 targets are 12-14% EBITA margin and 5-7% currency-adjusted growth), so this is a new-numbers print on a name whose real report days moved +12.5, -7.8, +0.7, -0.2, +9.9, +4.3 and +4.3. I put the move at 6% with almost no directional lean: an easy organic comparison, a slight swing in currency translation and a beat-and-rally pattern on three straight prints, against SEB's 2 October downgrade that consensus already has margins at the top of the target and a 6% pullback from the 12 October high. The scaled number (+0.36) and the findings sum (+0.30) agree because nothing decisive was found.

already_public.what: Q2 2026: revenue SEK 7,891m, currency-adjusted growth 9.1%, organic 6.7%, EBITA SEK 1,102m at 14.0% margin (record); segment USA EBITA margin 18.4%
Transportadora del Interior (Argentina) closed 7 July and is consolidated in Q3; Hermes (Peru) closed 5 October (Q4)

No profit warning, trading update or other inside-information release from Loomis since the Q2 report; the Nasdaq Nordic feed carries only the Peru closing (5 Oct) and the nomination committee (28 Sep)
Financial targets 2025-2027: currency-adjusted revenue CAGR of 5-7%, EBITA margin of 12-14% for the whole period; no annual guidance

new_in_release.expect: Q3 organic growth and EBITA margin against an easy comparison (Q3 2025 organic 3.9%, EBITA SEK 1,006m at 13.2%). A modest beat is the lean, but I could not find a Q3 2026 consensus figure.

Margin commentary against the 12-14% target, with Q2 already at 14.0% and Q3 seasonally strong. A margin above the range would raise the target question, but no new targets or capital markets day are scheduled. Direction unknown.
Operating cash flow conversion (R12 95% in Q2) and net debt after two Latin American deals. No view.
Possible buyback news. None has been announced in 2026, while the company bought back SEK 200m in Q3 2025. Unknown.
None given; the company does not guide. The only possible guidance-type event is a target update, and nothing points to one.

bar: unsourced for Q3 2026, so every finding is capped small. Context: Modular Finance consensus for Q3 2025 EBITA was SEK 990m against an actual 1,006m (https://borsvarlden.com/artiklar/loomis-ebita-resultat-nagot-hogre-an-vantat-uppdatering). Q2 2026 EBITA came in at 1,102m against an expected 1,033m (https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/FWM00E432C). SEB says Infront consensus already has the EBITA margin at the top of the 12-14% target by 2027 (https://www.placera.se/telegram/loomis-seb-sanker-loomis-till-behall-hojer-riktkursen-till-600-kronor-20261002).
session_check: bmo. The issuer's own financial calendar (Investis widget on loomis.com) lists '30 October 2026, Quarterly results, Interim Report, January - September 2026'. The last four interim reports went out at 07:30 CET/CEST, before the Stockholm open (Q2 2026: 'submitted for publication ... at 07.30 a.m. (CEST) on July 24, 2026'). Sources: https://otp.tools.investis.com/clients/sv/loomis_ab1/EventCalendar/EventCalendar.aspx?culture=en-US and https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bae7af6b1b52c94b4b9a42184cd2ea016&lang=en&src=listed
positioning_check: Finansinspektionen aggregate net short is 0.8% (position_date 2026-10-27, as of 2026-10-29; https://www.fi.se/sv/vara-register/blankningsregistret/GetBlankningsregisterAggregat/). FI's current per-holder file (GetAktuellFile) names no single holder at or above 0.5% in Loomis, so the 0.8% is spread across small positions. The short is light and not crowded. The register is a snapshot, so the change is unknown rather than zero, although the level last moved on 27 October.

findings.finding: Q3 2025 is an easy organic comparison (3.9%, against 6.7% in Q2 2026). Q2 showed broad momentum: segment USA at a record 18.4% EBITA margin and double-digit growth in International and Automated Solutions. Brink's said on 5 August that it had closed customer wins supporting 'continued growth momentum into the second half'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EBITA beats on the last two prints (Q1 and Q2 2026, Q2 at +6.7% vs the expected 1,033m) were met with +4.3% and +4.3%. The Q4 2025 print moved +9.9%. The Q3 2025 print, a small EBITA beat with an EPS miss, moved -0.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The stock rallied from about 520 after Q2 to a 582 high on 12 October, and analysts raised targets (SEB 600, ABG 620). The one unpriced part would be the size of the Q3 margin step, and no consensus figure was found to measure it against.

findings.finding: Currency translation turns from a headwind to roughly neutral or slightly positive. USD/SEK averaged 9.65 in Q3 2026 against 9.51 in Q3 2025 (+1.5%), where Q2 had 9.37 against 9.66 (-3.1%). EUR/SEK was flat (11.10 against 11.12). In H1, segment USA carried a -9.6% exchange-rate effect.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q3 2025 'the strengthening of the krona had a materially negative effect on revenue in all segments', on a print that moved -0.2%. No clean history of a reaction to FX alone.
findings.why_not_priced: A public FX series that every sell-side model translates, so it is largely in consensus. It is filed because it changes reported SEK EBITA by about 1% against Q2's run-rate. If it were not priced, estimates would sit below Q2's currency-adjusted trend, and I cannot show that.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 report, segment USA exchange-rate effect of -9.6% in H1: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aee5ec5b44032d9ce773684aa0008a2ea

findings.finding: Expectations are already high. SEB cut Loomis to hold on 2 October, saying Infront consensus already has the EBITA margin reaching the top of its 12-14% target by 2027, which limits room for further upgrades. The stock has since fallen about 6% from its 12 October all-time high of 582 to 546.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Q2 2025 report (+0.7% on the day), SEB dropped its buy rating on 28 July 2025 (https://placera.se/nyheter/seb-slopar-kopstampel-pa-loomis---har-ar-dagens-rekar-2025-07-28). The Q3 2025 print that followed moved -0.2% on the day.
findings.original_quote: Samtidigt väntas Loomis enligt Infronts konsensus nå den övre delen av sitt mål för ebita-marginalen senast 2027, vilket SEB bedömer begränsar utrymmet för ytterligare resultatuppjusteringar. (At the same time, Infront consensus expects Loomis to reach the upper part of its EBITA-margin target by 2027, which SEB judges limits the room for further earnings upgrades.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The 6% pullback from the high and a -2.1% 20-day run-up suggest some of it is in. What would remain is that a merely in-line margin disappoints a consensus already sitting at the top of the range. A fully priced version would show the stock back near its post-Q2 level of about 520.
findings.independence: ABG raised its target to 620 and kept buy on 9 Oct (https://www.placera.se/telegram/loomis-abg-sundal-collier-hojer-riktkursen-till-620-kr-560-20261009), which cuts the other way, so there is no independent support for the negative.

findings.finding: Fuel price indexation probably adds to Q3 revenue again. WTI averaged roughly 85-90 USD in Q3 2026 against the low 60s in Q3 2025, and in Q2 the company said 'price indexation related to higher fuel prices' contributed positively to revenue but is 'more non-recurring in nature'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First flagged in Q2 2026, a print that moved +4.3%. No separate reaction measurable.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy, and the company itself labels the effect non-recurring, so a beat built on it is lower quality and may be discounted. Fuel is also a cost, so the margin effect is ambiguous. Small.

findings.finding: The Argentina acquisition Transportadora del Interior (EV about ARS 27.5bn, roughly SEK 180m) is consolidated from July and 'doubles our size in Argentina'. The company expects a positive contribution to group EBITA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Acquisition contribution has never been the line that moved a Loomis print.
findings.why_not_priced: Announced and closed publicly, and small relative to group revenue of more than SEK 30bn, so it is essentially in the models.

findings.finding: Outgoing CFO Johan Wilsby sold 6,400 shares at SEK 530 on 26 August 2026 (about SEK 3.4m), after his successor Tobias Hägglöv was named to start on 14 September. Q3 is the new CFO's first report.
findings.original_quote: Johan Wilsby | Ekonomichef/finanschef/finansdirektör | Avyttring | 2026-08-26 | 6 400 | 530,00 SEK (Disposal by the CFO)
findings.why_not_priced: A departing executive selling carries almost no information about the quarter, and the sale was public on FI's register two months ago. Filed because the core requires every sourced fact to be filed, and sized near zero.

outside_window.finding: Brink's (largest listed peer) reports Q3 2026 on 4 November, after the window; Prosegur Cash's 9M report historically lands on about 31 October, also after it
Hermes Transportes Blindados (Peru) closed 5 October, so it is consolidated in Q4, not Q3

rejected_candidates.candidate: Precious metals volatility (gold 4,038 to 4,482 to 4,187 over Q3 2026) as a driver of the International business line
rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the momentum finding, which already cites the company's statement that International was driven by precious-metals demand; a commodity price series adds no company-level number

rejected_candidates.candidate: A one-off 5.1% drop on 2025-11-03, mistaken at first for the Q3 2025 reaction
rejected_candidates.detail: MFN dates the Q3 2025 report 2025-10-31 (a -0.2% day), so the 11-03 drop is not a print reaction and was not used in the reaction history

baseline_tension: Broadly agrees. The lean is +0.58 (light short squeeze plus a small run-up term) and the run-ups are mildly negative (-2.1% over 20 days, -2.2% over 5 days); my evidence leans only slightly positive and is offset by a demanding bar.
language_note: The Swedish Finwire telegram on placera.se carried SEB's reasoning: Infront consensus already has margins at the top of the 12-14% target. The English sources I found carried no Q3 preview at all.
FI's Swedish-language insider register (insynsregistret) carried the outgoing CFO's August sale. English sources did not, but it is near-zero information.
Every Loomis filing is published in Swedish and English at the same moment, so the filings themselves added nothing in Swedish.
lessons_applied: abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 6.0. The numbers are new (nothing pre-released) and the European base for new numbers is about 7%; the name's own real report-day moves have a median of 4.3% with a tail at 7.8-12.5%, and coverage sits in the 3-7 band. Certainty about the sign was not allowed to shrink the move.
The CFO-sale finding was cut from -0.1 to -0.05, because my own caveat (a departing executive's sale carries no information) has to reach the number.
p_up kept at 53. The beats-were-bought history is offset by SEB's high-bar warning, and the bar is unsourced, which keeps p_up near 50.
